purpose: Canonical evidence file for 2023. Only sourced records in this file are eligible for later card scoring.

records.title: US banking crisis temporarily depegs USDC
records.summary: Silicon Valley Bank was closed on March 10. Circle disclosed that $3.3 billion of USDC reserves were held there, about 8% of reserves, and USDC temporarily traded below its dollar peg before regulators guaranteed access to deposits.
records.significance: The episode showed that even fully reserved stablecoins inherit risk from traditional banking infrastructure and connected crypto's stablecoin system directly to a real-world bank run.

records.title: Signature Bank is closed by regulators
records.summary: New York regulators closed Signature Bank on March 12 and appointed the FDIC as receiver.
records.significance: Signature's failure, alongside Silvergate and SVB, sharply reduced US banking access for the crypto sector and intensified the 2023 crypto-banking crisis.

records.title: Silvergate announces voluntary wind-down
records.summary: Silvergate announced on March 8 that it would wind down operations and voluntarily liquidate after severe deposit losses following the FTX collapse.
records.significance: Silvergate's exit removed one of crypto's most important banking partners and became the first domino in the March 2023 US crypto-banking crisis.

records.title: Ethereum Shapella enables staking withdrawals
records.summary: Ethereum's Shanghai-Capella upgrade activated at epoch 194,048 and enabled validators to withdraw staked ETH and rewards from the Beacon Chain.
records.significance: Shapella closed the liquidity loop for proof-of-stake Ethereum and removed one of the final constraints inherited from the pre-Merge staking transition.

records.title: SEC sues Binance and Changpeng Zhao
records.summary: The US SEC filed 13 charges against Binance entities and founder Changpeng Zhao, alleging securities-law violations including operating unregistered exchange, broker and clearing functions.
records.significance: The case represented one of the largest US civil enforcement actions ever brought against a global crypto exchange.

sources.title: SEC — Charges Against Binance and Zhao

records.title: SEC sues Coinbase
records.summary: The SEC charged Coinbase with operating an unregistered securities exchange, broker and clearing agency and challenged its staking-as-a-service program.
records.significance: The lawsuit put the leading US-listed crypto exchange into direct conflict with the country's securities regulator over the legal status of crypto markets.

records.title: BlackRock files for a spot Bitcoin ETF
records.summary: BlackRock-sponsored iShares Bitcoin Trust filed its Form S-1 and Nasdaq filed the proposed rule change to list the trust on June 15, 2023.
records.significance: The filing transformed the long-running US spot-Bitcoin ETF debate because the world's largest asset manager was now pursuing a product, helping trigger a wave of competing applications.

sources.title: SEC EDGAR — iShares Bitcoin Trust S-1

records.title: Ripple receives partial summary-judgment victory in SEC case
records.summary: A federal court ruled that Ripple's institutional XRP sales satisfied Howey, while programmatic secondary-market sales did not on the record before the court.
records.significance: The mixed ruling became one of the most important US judicial decisions on how securities law can apply differently depending on the manner in which a crypto asset is sold.

sources.title: SEC filing summarizing Ripple Labs ruling

records.notes: Do not simplify this to 'XRP ruled not a security'; the court differentiated transaction types.

records.title: PayPal launches PYUSD stablecoin
records.summary: PayPal launched PayPal USD, an Ethereum ERC-20 stablecoin issued by Paxos and backed by dollar deposits, short-term US Treasuries and similar cash equivalents.
records.significance: A global consumer-payments company issuing its own regulated dollar stablecoin was a major bridge between mainstream fintech and on-chain payments.

sources.title: PayPal — PayPal Launches U.S. Dollar Stablecoin

records.title: Base mainnet opens to everyone
records.summary: Coinbase-incubated Base opened its Ethereum layer-2 mainnet to the public on August 9 after an earlier developer launch and bridging period.
records.significance: Base gave a major centralized crypto company a widely used on-chain L2 ecosystem and became an important driver of consumer applications and Ethereum rollup adoption.

records.title: Grayscale wins court challenge against SEC
records.summary: The D.C. Circuit granted Grayscale's petition for review and vacated the SEC's order denying conversion of GBTC into a Bitcoin exchange-traded product.
records.significance: The ruling weakened the SEC's rationale for treating spot Bitcoin ETPs differently from Bitcoin futures products and became a major precursor to January 2024 approvals.

records.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is convicted on seven criminal counts
records.summary: A federal jury convicted Sam Bankman-Fried of two wire-fraud conspiracies, two wire-fraud counts, money-laundering conspiracy, commodities-fraud conspiracy and securities-fraud conspiracy.
records.significance: The conviction became the legal culmination of FTX's collapse and one of the most important criminal verdicts in crypto history.

sources.title: US DOJ — Statement on SBF conviction

records.title: Binance and CZ plead guilty in $4.3 billion US resolution
records.summary: Binance pleaded guilty to federal charges involving AML, money-transmission and sanctions violations, agreed to pay over $4 billion, and founder Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty to failing to maintain an effective AML program and resigned as CEO.
records.significance: The resolution was one of the largest corporate criminal settlements in US history and fundamentally changed leadership and compliance at the world's largest crypto exchange.
